description:
FOUND s509 (Fable, 2026-10-06), the speed review.  docs/speed-review-s509.md; measurements and profiles in ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s509/review/speed/ (prof.pl ROW... -> ROW.pl, ROW.lisp, ROW.prof; main b43188b5, gen v2-4280, load 5-6, best of 3-5)

MEASURED (2 M calls each, programs pr-*.pl in that directory, perl -> main):
     print {$fh} "x\n"      0.089 -> 0.292   3.3x          print $fh "x", "\n"     0.129 -> 0.364   2.8x
     print $fh "x\n"        0.092 -> 0.291   3.2x          print "x\n" (STDOUT)    0.074 -> 0.233   3.2x
     print $fh $x           0.093 -> 0.288   3.1x          print $fh "v=$i\n"      0.149 -> 0.578   3.9x
PROFILE (fhprint.prof): `%p-write-list` 47 % total; `p-flatten-args` 13 %, `%make-p-box` 8 %, `vector-to-list` 3 %,
`%p-resolve-fh` 14 %, `length` 6 %, the byte output itself 9 %.  The emission is `(p-print :fh $fh (p-esc "x\n"))` -- the
general &rest form for every spelling.

DIRECTION (needs a SHORT DESIGN NOTE before code): when every argument FORM is a scalar at compile time (a literal, an
interpolated string / p-string-concat, a scalar variable, a scalar-valued builtin) the expansion can call an N-scalar entry
(1, 2, 3 arguments, else the general one): no rest list, no flatten, no box.  It must keep ONE path for the semantics --
`$,` and `$\` (read once per call), a tied handle, an in-memory handle, the SELECTED handle for the no-handle form, the
`:utf8` / encoding layers, `print`'s return value, the closed-handle case.  A Kind-A gate in Pl/Passes.pm (named, switchable
by PCL_OPT) if the decision is made in the compiler; a compiler macro if it can be made from the forms alone.

EXPECTED: -40 to -50 % on fhprint and on any output-heavy loop (the flatten + box + list + lookup share of the profile).
NOT cheap in the sense of #2770: medium.  The bar includes the everyday corpus byte-identical and io/print.t, io/say.t.


=== s510p: B1 BUILT (1df430b9), task stays OPEN === fhprint -7.9 % (tree A/B) / -9.7 % (runtime A/B).  The box in the print profile is the LOOP's $_ box; removing it is #813, declined.  RESIDUE (next candidate): handle resolution %p-resolve-fh 13.7 % and the guarded write ~20 % (pthread_sigmask 2.5 %, output 8.6 %) -- a handle cache keyed on the glob.

=== s512p (perf round 41, 2026-10-09): the RESIDUE answered; task stays OPEN only for what is filed ===
Design note scratch/s512p/print2-design.md (worktree agent-ad4d28a21ff7f772a), RULED by Fable s513: build A1 only.
(a) A1 SHIPPED (commit "s512p #2771 residue (A1, ruled)"): %p-resolve-fh tests the p-box-p arm FIRST and the CLOS-class socket typep after the symbol arm; a lexical handle no longer pays %p-socket-p's classoid lookup (~6 % of fhprint).  A handle CACHE was rejected: nine invalidation sites (open, close, binmode #2777, select, tie, glob assignment, local *FH, dup-open, %p-rebuild-fd-stream) to save two type tests.  Hand-replaced A/B best of 5: fhprint 0.209 -> 0.189 s (-9.6 %, ~-13 % net of the preload's load), fhsep ($, $\) -4.7 %, control 0.0 %.  Designator probe table scratch/s512p/fh-designators.pl (41 lines: lexical, block, bareword, name string, glob, glob ref, dup, IO::Handle, select, socketpair, printf/say, closed, read-only) = perl on base and tree, exit 0 all three; the undef-designator shape (fh-undef.pl) differs from perl IDENTICALLY on base and tree (perl dies, PCL returns false) = #1421, pre-existing.  Guard rows Pl/t/perf-levers-10.t 5-6.
(b) NOTHING TO BUILD: the mask pair is the GC's (#813), not the write's -- pthread_sigmask's only caller in the fhprint graph is maybe_gc <- interrupt_handle_pending (allocation of the loop's $_ box); %p-with-signals-held is one branch with no %SIG handler.
A2 (output-stream-p is a gray generic; an fd-stream obuf test, ~3 % more) FILED as #2882, not built.
